description: Non-secret project settings: hosts, ports, endpoints, config. create, list (read), update (undo with manage_history), delete (undo restores it; with approvals on it waits for the user; refused for HTTP app keys and remote apps). Secrets are refused; is_secret only labels a value and does not hide it, so never store passwords, tokens or keys. Requires project. Returns variable rows.

action.description: The operation; see the tool description.

category.description: create / update: the group, default custom. list: filter.

description.description: create / update: what it is for.

is_secret.description: create / update: label as sensitive. It is still returned by list.

model.description: Model name if known. Never guess.

name.description: create: name, unique per project and category (required). update: a new name.

value.description: create / update: the setting as text. Never a secret.

name: manage_variables
